description: Presents and grades a question with multiple selectable answers.

examples.label: Example 1
examples.code:
Title
Web languages
Prompt
Select the styling languages, including CSS preprocessors.
Form
  • CSS
  • HTML
  • Sass
  • JavaScript
  • Less
Feedback
  • Correct. CSS describes presentation.
  • HTML structures content.
  • Correct. Sass is a CSS preprocessor.
  • JavaScript is a programming language.
  • Correct. Less is a CSS preprocessor.
Solution
CSS, Sass and Less are used to define styles.

attributes.name: answer
attributes.description: Comma-separated 1-based indexes of the correct answers in the original list order (e.g. `"1,3"`). An empty answer means none of the choices is correct. Not reflected back to the DOM when set via JS property — read from attribute only.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name passed to the underlying choice list.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Arrangement of answer choices: horizontal or vertical.

attributes.name: random
attributes.description: When present, items are shuffled on connect and after each reset.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL of an external JSON, HTML, Markdown, AsciiDoc or reStructuredText question definition. Keeps the definition out of authored markup, but does not make downloaded answers confidential.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Comma-separated 1-based indexes of the currently selected answers; empty means no selection.

methods.name: randomize(): void
methods.description: Randomizes the order of answer items.

dependencies.name: tp-checkbox-list
dependencies.summary: Transforms a list into a group of checkboxes.

dependencies.name: tp-question
dependencies.summary: Base description-list container for question components.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-multi-choice-question>` element presents and grades a question with multiple selectable answers.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Reading | Select every answer you consider correct, or leave all boxes unchecked if none applies, then submit. |
| Using the component | Review Feedback to understand the result or open Solution for the explanation. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between the available controls. |
| <kbd>Space</kbd> | Select the focused answer; in a multiple-choice question, toggle its checkbox. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> on Submit | Submit the current selection, including no checked boxes. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy under the pointer, or around the focused component, then open its help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
